rationale: With a 3M first data file and 32K pages the doublewrite buffer pages do not fit, and buf_dblwr_create could not report this and aborted. The size check and error return in buf_dblwr_create is the corrected logic. Other files add graceful abort paths or log changes, and several hunks were added and reverted between the two commits.
